title: Watch Duty: Clear the Road
summary: Skeletons are shooting at carts on the road. The Watch wants it clear.

dialogue.intro: Two carts came in with arrows in the sides this week. Skeletons, on the road at dusk.
offer: Six would make the road safe for a while.
Then the carts get through, and we eat.
dialogue.reward: The carts came in clean this morning. Here.
dialogue.done: The road's been clear since you went out.
